functional_rationale: Group-of-images is an authored application of the independently documented group/set noun, not an established assembly/project term. The storage predicate explicitly names data, preserving the editable grouping state with positions, crop/normalization and constituent references rather than flattened PNG output.

Opening uses the already accepted own digital loading-unavailable frame. Saved group means the existing persisted working-state category; it does not claim the current save succeeded or any particular source bytes are corrupt. It can fail after partial parsing.

One absent image is scoped to this group. The caller also rejects a source outside its permitted directory; absence is relative to the expected valid source set, not a claim of deletion, failure of every source, or missing project.json.
